stem:
Farhan compares a broad, flat green spinach leaf with a narrow green grass blade under the same sunlight. Both leaves make food.

Which claim best explains why the broad, flat leaf makes food more efficiently?

options.text: Its broad, flat surface gives a larger chlorophyll-containing area to receive sunlight for photosynthesis.
Its broad, flat shape captures more sunlight for respiration, which makes the food.
Its broad, flat green surface can make food even in complete darkness.
Under the same sunlight, the broader leaf makes less food because its light is spread more thinly.

teacher.key_rationale: Leaves are the main food-making site; a broad, flat shape gives a larger sunlight-receiving, chlorophyll-containing surface for photosynthesis. Respiration does not make food; darkness blocks photosynthesis; spreading light thinner does not mean less food under the same sunlight for a larger surface.
